Os temas relacionais dos níveis evolutivos não foram importados para o perfil geral. A passagem mitológica de aula 0 e a repetição em aula 5 não foram usadas como evidência adicional.

Scorpio.pt: a energia de Escorpião no seu mapa expressa reforma, investigação e estratégia, orientando a força destrutiva para um objetivo construtivo. ela pode tender à crueldade, à vingança ou à agressividade.
Scorpio.en: in your chart, Scorpio energy expresses reform, investigation, and strategy, directing destructive force toward a constructive aim. it may tend toward cruelty, revenge, or aggression.
reviewNotes: A descrição mantém a orientação construtiva da força destrutiva explicitada no texto. Crueldade, vingança e agressividade são apresentadas como tendências possíveis, não como diagnóstico ou biografia.
Os níveis evolutivos e a parábola mitológica de aula 0 não foram convertidos em afirmações pessoais; a repetição em aula 5 não foi usada como evidência adicional.

Sagittarius.pt: no seu mapa, a energia de Sagitário reúne filosofia, cultura, religião, justiça e independência, com funções de compreender, educar e orientar. ela também pode se manifestar como fanfarronice, licenciosidade ou cupidez.
Sagittarius.en: in your chart, the energy of Sagittarius brings together philosophy, culture, religion, justice and independence, with functions of understanding, educating and guiding. it may also manifest as boastfulness, licentiousness or greed.
reviewNotes: modulo 4/aula 4 modulo 4/aula-4.md:182-205 inspected in full. Adopted only general qualities/functions/vices at 182-186: philosophy, culture, religion, justice, independence, understanding/education/guidance and possible boastfulness/licentiousness/greed. Vices remain possible expressions of sign energy in the chart, not assigned character or an evolutionary level.

Evolutionary-level branches at modulo 4/aula 4 modulo 4/aula-4.md:187-204 are inspected but unadopted, including long-distance travel through dissatisfaction, inner teaching/faith and initiatic/master themes. They are not merged into one person. Optional A0 parable, A5 duplicates and book were not inspected or adopted.

Capricorn.pt: no seu mapa, a energia de Capricórnio reúne concentração, paciência e constância, com funções de pensar, deduzir e concretizar. ela também pode se manifestar como avareza, exploração das falhas alheias, ironia ou pessimismo.
Capricorn.en: in your chart, the energy of Capricorn brings together concentration, patience and constancy, with functions of thinking, deducing and making things concrete. it may also manifest as avarice, exploitation of others’ failings, irony or pessimism.
reviewNotes: modulo 4/aula 4 modulo 4/aula-4.md:206-239 inspected in full. Adopted only general qualities/functions/vices at 206-210, preserving concentration/patience/constancy, thinking/deduction/concretization and possible avarice/exploitation/irony/pessimism. The wording concerns chart energy, not an automatic Sun/Ascendant identity or bad-person label.

Evolutionary levels at modulo 4/aula 4 modulo 4/aula-4.md:211-236 are inspected but unadopted, including status/power compensation, social inhibition, profession and mature responsibility/destiny claims. Stray Uranus label at 238 is not Capricorn evidence. Optional A0 parable, A5 duplicates and book were not inspected or adopted.

Aquarius.pt: no seu mapa, a energia de Aquário reúne intuição, inventividade, originalidade, altruísmo e cooperação, com funções de instruir, inventar e renovar. ela também pode se manifestar como rebelião, anarquia, inadaptação ou extravagância.
Aquarius.en: in your chart, the energy of Aquarius brings together intuition, inventiveness, originality, altruism and cooperation, with functions of teaching, inventing and renewing. it may also manifest as rebellion, anarchy, difficulty adapting or extravagance.
reviewNotes: modulo 4/aula 4 modulo 4/aula-4.md:240-267 inspected in full. Adopted only general qualities/functions/vices at 240-245. Inadaptação is rendered as difficulty adapting, not a diagnosis. Rebellion/anarchy/extravagance are possible sign-energy expressions, not an assigned level or fixed biography.

Evolutionary levels at modulo 4/aula 4 modulo 4/aula-4.md:246-265 are inspected but unadopted: friendship, teamwork/social transformation and cosmic-consciousness branches remain separate source stages. Neptune label at 267 supplies no Aquarius trait. Optional A0 parable, A5 duplicates and book were not inspected or adopted.

Pisces.pt: no seu mapa, a energia de Peixes reúne inspiração, caridade e humildade, com funções de confiar e servir com sacrifício e abnegação. ela também pode se manifestar como impressionabilidade, hesitação, fantasia ou intriga.
Pisces.en: in your chart, the energy of Pisces brings together inspiration, charity and humility, with functions of trusting and serving with sacrifice and selflessness. it may also manifest as impressionability, hesitation, fantasy or intrigue.
reviewNotes: modulo 4/aula 4 modulo 4/aula-4.md:268-286 inspected in full. Adopted only general qualities/functions at 268-271 and intrigue from the vices at 272. Impressionability, hesitation and fantasy come from the general list, not from an invented negative level. Service with sacrifice/selflessness is a descriptive function, not recommended conduct.

The obsession/hallucination labels at modulo 4/aula 4 modulo 4/aula-4.md:272 are unadopted as reader claims. Evolutionary branches at 273-286, including isolation/escape, emotional projection and liberated higher-self unity, are inspected but unadopted; no personal level or promised peace is assigned. Optional A0 parable, A5 duplicates and book were not inspected or adopted.

fire.pt: no seu mapa, o fogo se associa à iniciativa, à ambição e a reações vivas, demonstrativas e combativas. simbolicamente, o fogo é quente e seco, representa impulso para começar e corresponde ao temperamento sanguíneo.
fire.en: in your chart, fire is associated with initiative, ambition, and lively, demonstrative, combative reactions. symbolically, fire is hot and dry, represents the impulse to begin, and corresponds to the sanguine temperament.
reviewNotes: Independent A2 initiative/ambition and lively/demonstrative/combative clauses, A3 symbolic hot/dry qualities and A8 start metaphor remain adopted. A8:813 supplies only the sanguine temperament label; the temperature/blood/humor clauses at811-813 are not adopted.

Historical disagreement: A2:137 calls fire bilious and A3:65 irritable, while A8:813 calls it sanguine. Mat selected A8 labels on2026-11-16; the other mappings remain recorded rather than silently blended.

A2:138 explicitly attributes spirituality, enthusiasm and desire for honors to its temperament context; these traits are not transferred to A8's selected label. A2:137 shares the adopted reaction clause with an unadopted bilious mapping. No physical vitality or health outcome is claimed.

earth.pt: no seu mapa, a terra se associa a reações lentas e duradouras, prudência, método e ordem. sua orientação prática se volta ao concreto e ao material, com busca de estabilidade; simbolicamente, a terra é fria e seca e corresponde ao temperamento colérico.
earth.en: in your chart, earth is associated with slow, lasting reactions, prudence, method, and order. its practical orientation turns toward concrete and material matters, with a search for stability; symbolically, earth is cold and dry and corresponds to the choleric temperament.
reviewNotes: Independent A2 slow/lasting reactions, prudence/method/order and concrete/material orientation, A3 symbolic cold/dry qualities and A8 concretization/stability remain adopted. A8:804 supplies the choleric temperament label; the bile-humor clause is not adopted.
Historical disagreement: A2:144 and A3:66 call earth nervous, while A8:804 calls it choleric. Mat selected A8 labels on2026-11-16; the other mapping remains recorded.
A2:144-145 attributes tenacity, laboriousness and country tastes to its temperament context. Those traits are not transferred to A8's selected label. No somatic or health claim is made.

air.pt: no seu mapa, o elemento ar se associa à inteligência e às faculdades mentais, à rapidez de reação, à flexibilidade e à adaptação. em termos simbólicos, o ar é quente e úmido e corresponde ao temperamento fleumático.
air.en: in your chart, the air element is associated with intelligence and mental faculties, quick reactions, flexibility, and adaptability. symbolically, air is hot and moist and corresponds to the phlegmatic temperament.
reviewNotes: Independent A2 intelligence/mental faculties, quick reactions, flexibility/adaptation, A3 symbolic hot/moist qualities and A8 intellectual/rational/communicative roles remain adopted. A8:809 supplies the phlegmatic temperament label; the phlegm/mucus-humor clause is not adopted.
Historical disagreement: A2:150 and A3:67 call air sanguine, while A8:809 calls it phlegmatic. Mat selected A8 labels on2026-11-16; the other mapping remains recorded.
A2:151 attributes friendship, concord and equity to its temperament context. Those traits are not transferred to A8's selected label. No physiological or health outcome is claimed.

water.pt: no seu mapa, o elemento água se associa à disposição impressionável, a reações lentas e a uma natureza imaginativa. em termos simbólicos, a água é fria e úmida, com energia fluídica e ênfase no controle das emoções, e corresponde ao temperamento melancólico.
water.en: in your chart, the water element is associated with an impressionable disposition, slow reactions, and an imaginative nature. symbolically, water is cold and moist, with fluid energy and an emphasis on emotional control, and corresponds to the melancholic temperament.
reviewNotes: Independent A2 impressionability, slow reactions and imagination, A3 symbolic cold/moist qualities and A8 fluid-energy/emotional-control metaphor remain adopted. A8:807 supplies the melancholic temperament label; the lymph-humor clause is not adopted.
Historical disagreement: A2:156 calls water phlegmatic and A3:68 lymphatic, while A8:807 calls it melancholic. Mat selected A8 labels on2026-11-16; the other mappings remain recorded.

A2:157 attributes inconstancy, dissimulation and pleasure-seeking to its temperament context. Those traits are not transferred to A8's selected label. Emotional-control wording remains symbolic, without a physiological promise or guaranteed outcome.

Cardinal.pt: no seu mapa, a modalidade cardinal marca o início de uma estação e se associa à atividade, à energia e à iniciativa. essa dinâmica também pode envolver ambição e aversão a limitações.
Cardinal.en: in your chart, the cardinal modality marks the beginning of a season and is associated with activity, energy, and initiative. this dynamic may also involve ambition and aversion to limitations.
reviewNotes: Adopted the season-start framing and initiative from A1 and activity/energy/initiative/ambition plus aversion to limitations from A2. A2's sign-by-sign scale qualification at lines 119-120 was inspected; no sign-specific distinction is made here.
A8 lines 913-918 was inspected but not adopted: its esoteric first-contact/simple/Ser framing is distinct from the ordinary rhythm profile and is not assigned personally.

Fixed.pt: no seu mapa, a modalidade fixa marca o meio de uma estação e se associa à estabilidade. essa dinâmica reúne vontade firme, perseverança e fidelidade, e pode envolver resistência a mudanças.
Fixed.en: in your chart, the fixed modality marks the middle of a season and is associated with stability. this dynamic brings together strong will, perseverance, and fidelity, and may involve resistance to change.
reviewNotes: Adopted the season-middle framing and stability from A1 and will/firmness/stability/perseverance/fidelity plus aversion to change from A2.
A8 lines 920-924 was inspected but not adopted: its esoteric deepening/Realizar and sacred-status language belongs to a distinct framework and is not assigned personally.

Mutable.pt: no seu mapa, a modalidade mutável se associa ao fim de uma estação e à passagem para a seguinte. essa dinâmica pode reunir instabilidade, dualidade e indecisão, junto de adaptabilidade e flexibilidade.
Mutable.en: in your chart, the mutable modality is associated with the end of a season and the transition to the next. this dynamic may include instability, duality and indecision, alongside adaptability and flexibility.
reviewNotes: Adopted A1's season-end/common-sign framing and explicit mutability; A2 describes the transition toward the next season and lists duality, indecision, perplexity, adaptability, and flexibility.

A8 lines 926-930 was inspected but not adopted: its transformation/mastery-consummation/synthesis-transcendence branch is kept distinct and no personal level or mastery is inferred. A8 lines 902-906 mentions past/present/future but the assigned passage contains no allocation table; no time mapping is adopted.

positive.pt: no seu mapa, a polaridade positiva descreve energia voltada à ação, à atividade e à vida exterior, que responde aos estímulos e acontecimentos externos. na nomenclatura simbólica, também é chamada masculina, ativa, diurna, ímpar e yang; esses rótulos não definem gênero nem valor moral.
positive.en: in your chart, positive polarity describes energy directed toward action, activity, and outer life, responding to external stimuli and events. in symbolic terminology, it is also called masculine, active, diurnal, odd, and yang; these labels define neither gender nor moral value.
reviewNotes: Adopted A2's action, activity, and outer-life wording and response to external events, alongside A11's extroverted/self-expressive description. Masculine, diurnal, odd, and yang are presented only as symbolic category names, not biological or moral claims.
A2's claim about women at102 was inspected and excluded. This generic definition makes no sign assignment and introduces no sign classifier.

Mat resolved the general Capricorn association on2026-11-16: feminine/negative per A2:104-105 and A11:191-194. A18:666-670 calls Capricorn masculine in its Lilith/Priapo context; that different source context remains recorded. The generic display copy and query namespace are unchanged.

negative.pt: no seu mapa, a polaridade negativa descreve energia receptiva e voltada à vida interior, que acolhe influências, acumula impressões e ganha experiências. na nomenclatura simbólica, também é chamada feminina, passiva, noturna, par e yin; esses rótulos não definem gênero nem valor moral.
negative.en: in your chart, negative polarity describes receptive energy directed toward inner life, taking in influences, accumulating impressions, and gaining experience. in symbolic terminology, it is also called feminine, passive, nocturnal, even, and yin; these labels define neither gender nor moral value.
reviewNotes: Adopted A2's receptivity, inward life, adaptation to influences, accumulation of impressions, and gaining experience, together with A11's introverted/receptive description. Feminine, passive, nocturnal, even, and yin are presented only as symbolic category names, not biological or moral claims.
A2's claim about men at109-110 was inspected and excluded. This generic definition makes no sign assignment and introduces no sign classifier.

Mat resolved the general Capricorn association on2026-11-16: feminine/negative per A2:104-105 and A11:191-194. A18:666-670 calls Capricorn masculine in its Lilith/Priapo context; that different source context remains recorded. The generic display copy and query namespace are unchanged.

ascendant.pt: no seu mapa, o Ascendente aponta a face que você apresenta ao mundo e as características que mostra. também se relaciona a como os outros veem você num primeiro contato e ao que você vê neles.
ascendant.en: in your chart, the Ascendant points to the face you present to the world and the qualities you show. it also relates to how others see you on first contact and what you see in them.
reviewNotes: Adopted the presented face, shown qualities, and first-impression meanings from lines 77-79. No sign, house-rulership, or biography claim was imported.

mc.pt: no seu mapa, o Meio-do-Céu aponta vocações, aspirações e ambições, além do rumo para onde você quer ir. também se relaciona à vida social, reputação, profissão, posição social e imagem pública.
mc.en: in your chart, the Midheaven points to vocations, aspirations, and ambitions, as well as the direction you want to take. it also relates to social life, reputation, profession, social standing, and public image.
reviewNotes: Adopted the vocational, aspirational, social, reputational, professional, status, and public-image themes from lines 124-127.
Inspected lines 55-57 and 118-123 but did not adopt the source's description of MC as zenith or its house-cusp association. MC is treated here as a chart angle independent of numbered house cusps.

dc.pt: no seu mapa, o Descendente representa o outro em relação ao eu e aquilo que você busca nas outras pessoas. esse tema se estende a diferentes relações, como parcerias de trabalho, conjugalidade e amizade.
dc.en: in your chart, the Descendant represents the other in relation to the self and what you seek in other people. this theme extends across relationships such as business partnerships, marriage, and friendship.
reviewNotes: Adopted the other/self contrast and what one seeks in others across relationships, including business partnership, spouse, and friendship. No house-system rule or partner outcome is asserted.

ic.pt: no seu mapa, o Fundo-do-Céu aponta suas origens, raízes e sua vida interior. também se relaciona ao lar e à infância.
ic.en: in your chart, the Imum Coeli points to your origins, roots, and inner self. it also relates to home and childhood.
reviewNotes: Adopted origins, family roots, home, childhood, and inner self from lines 134-137. Omitted the source's claim about a final resting place and its good/bad character framing; no house-cusp association is treated as universal.

conjunction.pt: no seu mapa, a conjunção reúne energias quando os planetas ocupam o mesmo ou quase o mesmo grau. a forma como elas atuam juntas depende da compatibilidade entre essas energias, e numa aproximação estreita uma pode se sobrepor à outra.
conjunction.en: in your chart, the conjunction brings energies together when planets occupy the same or nearly the same degree. how they work together depends on their compatibility, and at a close orb one may overshadow the other.
reviewNotes: Adopted the shared/nearly shared position, joining of energies, compatibility qualification, and the possibility that one energy may overshadow the other at a narrow orb.
Class 13 lines 405-429 inspected but its metaphysical and temporal claims were not adopted.

duodecile.pt: no seu mapa, o semissextil se associa a ajustes e harmonização entre as energias envolvidas. ele também envolve o desejo de recomeçar e de concentrar novas possibilidades.
duodecile.en: in your chart, the semisextile is associated with adjustment and harmonization between the energies involved. it also involves the desire to start again and to bring new possibilities together.
reviewNotes: The API key is duodecile. A13's SEMI-SEXTIL section at 561-563 and body at 598-609 describe adjustment and harmonization at the angle used by this API key; the display copy uses semissextil/semisextile, following the section terminology, while the query key remains duodecile without new aliases.

A13's later list conflicts in terminology: 1549 labels the 30-degree entry Decil or semi quintil and 1550 labels Semi sextil at 36 degrees. This naming discrepancy is recorded, not used to rename the API key or change calculations. Restarting and convergence of new possibilities are described as desire, not a promised growth outcome.
Root reread A13:625-631: the desire to restart and convergence of new possibilities are adopted directly; they are not transformed into an external opportunity or guaranteed growth outcome.

Display terminology follows the actual section heading at A13:561: semissextil in Portuguese and semisextile in English. Canonical query key duodecile, aspect angle, natal meaning and unsupported alias behavior remain unchanged.

octile.pt: no seu mapa, a semiquadratura se associa à ação diante de resistência. ela expressa uma dinâmica ativa dentro de limites.
octile.en: in your chart, the semisquare is associated with action in the face of resistance. it expresses active dynamics within limits.
reviewNotes: The API key is octile. The SEMIQUADRATURA section describes action and resistance and says its dynamic qualities operate within defined limits; the profile keeps that general theme without the section's planetary examples.
A13:784-791 discusses a future crisis, its possible avoidance, and favorable results. Those predictions and outcomes are excluded; the profile does not add a stress or aspect-pair condition.

Display terminology follows the actual section heading at A13:764: semiquadratura in Portuguese and semisquare in English. Canonical query key octile, aspect angle, natal meaning and unsupported alias behavior remain unchanged.

sextile.pt: no seu mapa, o sextil indica facilidade, com potencial benéfico e construtivo. ele também pode trazer tensão se a energia envolvida não for liberada.
sextile.en: in your chart, the sextile indicates ease, with beneficial and constructive potential. it can also bring tension if the energy involved is not released.
reviewNotes: Adopted Class 11's facilitator/beneficial potential and qualification that tension can arise if energy is not released. Class 13's constructive and facilitating description was used compatibly. At 942-943 only the facilitation clause is adopted; certainty and event/outcome clauses sharing those lines and continuing through 953 are excluded.
Class 11's sign-pair examples and polarity classification at 165-190 were not adopted.

square.pt: no seu mapa, a quadratura descreve tensão e conflito entre energias, podendo apresentar um desafio ou exigir uma solução. pode ter efeito energizante ou manifestar-se como conflito ou bloqueio, dependendo dos planetas envolvidos, e também motivar a superação de dificuldades.
square.en: in your chart, the square describes tension and conflict between energies, potentially presenting a challenge or requiring a solution. it can have an energizing effect or appear as conflict or blockage, depending on the planets involved, and can also motivate overcoming difficulties.
reviewNotes: Adopted tension/conflict, challenge or solution, possible energizing/conflict/blockage effects, and motivation to overcome difficulties. Effects are qualified as possibilities.
Class 11 sign/modality lists at 211-213 and Class 13 lines 1066-1152 were inspected but not used; the latter's fatalistic, health, and relationship claims are excluded.

trine.pt: no seu mapa, o trígono sugere harmonia e facilidade entre as energias envolvidas, com potencial benéfico. como tende a não exigir tanto esforço, pode haver menos empenho e, conforme o tema, menor valorização.
trine.en: in your chart, the trine suggests harmony and ease between the energies involved, with beneficial potential. because it may require less effort, there can be less exertion and, depending on the subject, less appreciation.
reviewNotes: Adopted the harmony/benefit description and preserved the source's qualification that ease may mean less effort and, depending on the theme, less appreciation. No luck, wealth, or guaranteed outcome is claimed.
Class 11's triplicity relationship is not included. Class 13 lines 1292-1317 were inspected; its advice and fortune example were not adopted.

trioctile.pt: no seu mapa, a sesquiquadratura se associa ao esforço de elaborar dificuldades mentalmente. ela também põe em foco a busca de autoconhecimento.
trioctile.en: in your chart, the sesquisquare is associated with the effort to work through difficulties mentally. it also brings the search for self-knowledge into focus.
reviewNotes: The API key is trioctile; the source section is titled SESQUIQUADRATURA. A13:1377-1388 contains fractional-arithmetic errors and is not used for numeric prose. A13:1394-1396 gives the qualified natal clause about effort, difficulty, mental elaboration, and self-knowledge.

A13:1392-1396 says this discussion is more prominent in progressions than natal. Health, disease, pain, therapy, future-event prediction, and specialist progression claims are excluded. The later phrase at 1405-1408 about "these three angles" has an ambiguous antecedent and is not adopted.

Display terminology follows the actual section heading at A13:1376: sesquiquadratura in Portuguese and sesquisquare in English. Canonical query key trioctile, aspect angle, natal meaning and unsupported alias behavior remain unchanged.

quincunx.pt: no seu mapa, o quincunx se associa a ajustes. simbolicamente, ele pode representar uma força mediadora entre opostos.
quincunx.en: in your chart, the quincunx is associated with adjustments. symbolically, it may represent a mediating force between opposites.
reviewNotes: The API key is quincunx. A13:1563 gives the short adjustment gloss; A13:1434-1447 presents the mediation-between-opposites idea in a philosophical Jung/Plato discussion, so the copy marks this as symbolic rather than a guaranteed personal result.
A13:1410-1414 and 1455-1466 attach health, disease, cure, therapy and illness outcomes to this aspect. All such claims, neighboring aspect types and any guaranteed result are excluded.

A13:1452-1454 explicitly bridges the preceding philosophical image of opposites to the 150-degree aspect, tentatively. Its conditional symbolic status is preserved; the health clause beginning at1455 is excluded.

opposition.pt: no seu mapa, a oposição corresponde a planetas separados por 180 graus e formando uma linha reta. ela marca tensão entre dois polos.
opposition.en: in your chart, the opposition corresponds to planets separated by 180 degrees and forming a straight line. it marks tension between two poles.
reviewNotes: Class 13 at 405-406 and 1566 defines opposition through tension between poles. Class 11 at 287-290 instead describes a close relation and energetic harmony; following Mat's clarification, the harmony between positive/negative poles is recorded here in the audit only and is not inserted into the profile copy or used to classify signs.

parsFortunae.pt: no seu mapa, a Parte da Fortuna é um ponto virtual formado pela relação matemática entre Sol, Lua e Ascendente. ela aponta o que pode vir mais pela sorte que pelo esforço, incluindo bens, prestígio e reputação, em uma leitura que considera a posição e as relações planetárias do ponto e de seu regente.
parsFortunae.en: in your chart, the Part of Fortune is a virtual point formed by the mathematical relationship between the Sun, Moon, and Ascendant. it points to what may come more through good fortune than effort, including possessions, prestige, and reputation, read in light of the placement and planetary relations of the point and its ruler.
reviewNotes: Adopted the virtual-point definition and its Sun/Moon/Ascendant relation, the source's potential-baggage framing for possessions, prestige, and reputation, and the qualification to consider location, relationships, and ruler.

The passage attributes luck-related importance and attainment beyond effort to Valens; the profile preserves potential framing and makes no fortune guarantee. The natal point is not conflated with the whole Ark Annu 10 Wheel of Fortune.

Planetary relations are stated explicitly to avoid confusing the interpretive qualification with interpersonal relationships. A10:2567-2569 names the point's relation by sign with planets;2574-2578 includes the ruler's placement and relations. Bodily vitality is not inferred from the source's broader physical-body/life themes.

chiron.pt: no seu mapa, Quíron apresenta a imagem simbólica do curador ferido: reconhecer a própria vulnerabilidade pode ajudar a compreender a dor alheia. a imperfeição inevitável da condição humana se liga a temas de aceitação, perdão e compaixão.
chiron.en: in your chart, Chiron presents the symbolic image of the wounded healer: recognizing your own vulnerability may help you understand others' pain. the inevitable imperfection of the human condition is linked with themes of acceptance, forgiveness, and compassion.
reviewNotes: Adopted the source's symbolic wounded-healer image: recognizing one's own vulnerability may support understanding others' pain. The inevitable human-imperfection qualification, acceptance, forgiveness and compassion are preserved without a prescribed sequence or promised healing.

The Hercules/Kíriom myth is context for the metaphor, not a fixed biography or event assigned to a chart owner. No wound, illness, diagnosis, cure, relationship outcome, or healing guarantee is asserted; age/cycle and later placement-specific material are outside this concept profile.

The supplemental book at books/astrologia-hermetica/astrologia-hermetica.md:5756-5774 groups Chiron among software extras and calls the displayed collection spatial noise, with major transits named nearby at5784. This is limited methodological context, not a contrary Chiron natal profile; it provides no adopted personality wording and does not override the primary course.

A15:207-216 recommends considering Chiron with Pluto in a spiritual system. This is retained as contextual qualification without generating an unapproved planet-pair interpretation. Sun harmony/disharmony at192-200 and transits/cycles are not generalized into this concept.

lilith mean.pt: no seu mapa, Lilith representa simbolicamente uma área da consciência obscura e pouco acessível, figurada pela ausência de luz. a interpretação depende do conjunto do mapa e do grau, com características latentes que podem aparecer em intensidades diferentes, sem necessariamente chegar ao extremo.
lilith mean.en: in your chart, Lilith symbolically represents an obscure, difficult-to-access area of consciousness, figured as an absence of light. interpretation depends on the overall chart and degree, with latent characteristics that may appear at different intensities without necessarily reaching an extreme.
reviewNotes: Adopted the symbolic darkness/absence-of-light image for an obscure, difficult-to-access area of consciousness. Retained the actual qualifications: interpretation depends on chart/degree; intensity differs (152-155); characteristics are latent and need not reach extremes (159-160), rather than assuming total dormancy.

Excluded physical-vacuum claims, gendered odd/even moral classifications, corruption/evil/illegal labels, and practices. Priapus remains separate; the passage itself says it is not invariably opposite Lilith.

The cited concept does not distinguish mean and true calculation modes. Both verified chart keys share this one textual factor: the sole canonical record is lilith mean, with an explicit lilith true interpretation lookup alias. This does not equate their calculated positions and does not define a bare lilith default.

Aries.pt: com a Parte da Fortuna em Áries, você tende a buscar atividade e expressar iniciativa. nesse tema, sua expressão pode ser assertiva, pioneira e corajosa.
Aries.en: with the Part of Fortune in Aries, you may seek activity and express initiative. in this area, your approach may be assertive, pioneering, and courageous.
reviewNotes: Reframed activity and initiative as a chart tendency; the sign-mode clause supports assertive, pioneering, courageous expression. Excluded the claim that obstacles will be overcome and the assurance of sufficient energy/independence.
Table context at 2822-2830 distinguishes experience field from manner; only the sign-manner clause is used, not house-field content.

reviewNotes: The house-specific prose advises humility, flexibility and non-possessiveness, saying that giving up some ego may make a person happier. The table's house field emphasizes introspection and investigating life's basic mysteries. Advice is rendered as possible themes, not commands or guaranteed happiness.

The table context at 2822-2830 distinguishes house field from sign manner; Scorpio sign-column instructions at 2933-2937 are excluded. The source's mention of death at 2930-2931 is not turned into a prediction or outcome.

9.pt: com a Parte da Fortuna na Casa 9, sua realização se associa a ampliar a compreensão do mundo por viagens, filosofia e religião. viver e trabalhar no cotidiano, fazer o necessário sem esperar recompensas e ter prazer nas próprias realizações aparecem como temas de aprendizado.
9.en: with the Part of Fortune in House 9, your fulfillment is associated with expanding your understanding of the world through travel, philosophy, and religion. everyday life and work, doing what needs to be done without expecting rewards, and enjoying your accomplishments appear as learning themes.
reviewNotes: Mat clarified on2026-11-16: retain both source functions as distinct field of fulfillment and learning theme. The everyday-life passage at2762-2763 is not silently substituted for the table field at2941-2946, nor is a new balancing mechanism invented.
The table HOUSE field is used; the Sagittarius SIGN manner at2948-2951 is excluded. No prediction, reward promise or practice instruction is added.

10.pt: você pode desejar aceitação da comunidade ou de pessoas em posição de autoridade, dedicando esforço constante ao que busca. sua contribuição ao mundo e um rumo profissional que faça sentido para você também são temas de realização.
10.en: you may seek acceptance from the community or people in positions of authority, applying sustained effort to what you pursue. your contribution to the world and a professional direction that feels meaningful to you are also themes of fulfillment.
reviewNotes: The house-specific source describes desire for acceptance by community or authority, constant effort, and a view that right and wrong are not absolute. Its final OCR-corrupt clause is excluded. The house-column table material connects fulfillment with contribution to the world and professional concerns with personal fulfillment; wording is qualified rather than made a guarantee.

The table context at 2822-2830 distinguishes house field from sign manner. Table OCR interleaves the Capricorn sign column; only house-column fragments at 2955, 2958-2959, 2963-2964 and 2966 are cited. Sign-column text at 2956-2957, 2960, 2962, 2965 and 2967 is excluded.

11.pt: você pode sentir inquietação e a impressão recorrente de que ainda há algo a fazer ou criar. amizades, projetos coletivos e a busca de soluções com outras pessoas podem ocupar esse campo da sua vida.
11.en: you may feel restless and repeatedly sense that there is still something to do or create. friendships, collective projects and seeking solutions with other people may occupy this area of your life.
reviewNotes: The house-specific prose says energy is unlimited and that it provokes restlessness, with a constant sense that something remains to be done or created. The absolute claim of unlimited energy is omitted, and the source's separate instruction not to feel trapped by social restrictions is not converted into a causal condition.

The table's house-column material addresses friends, projects, relating to people and finding solutions together. Its Aquarius sign-column language at 2977-2982 is excluded; no outcome or guaranteed success is claimed.

12.pt: períodos de recolhimento podem favorecer a reflexão sobre sua vida interior, seus sonhos e imagens. esse espaço também pode ajudar você a ponderar seus vínculos e objetivos, mantendo atenção às pessoas que dependem de você.
12.en: periods of solitude may support reflection on your inner life, dreams and images. this space may also help you weigh your connections and goals while remaining mindful of people who depend on you.
reviewNotes: The house-specific passage says periods of isolation can be beneficial for weighing relationships and objectives, and cautions against thinking only of oneself. Its final OCR-damaged wording is not interpreted beyond the clear reference to people who depend on you.

The house-column table associates fulfillment with inner understanding, dreams and images, with some reserve or isolation. Pisces sign-column manner clauses are excluded. This is framed as a possible reflective use of solitude, not relationship advice or an outcome claim.

Aries.pt: com Quíron em Áries ou na Casa 1, você pode perceber tensão entre afirmar sua independência e buscar aceitação dos outros. você também pode ser amável e sociável, com a aceitação de si entre os temas de aprendizado.
Aries.en: with Chiron in Aries or the 1st House, you may notice tension between asserting your independence and seeking others' acceptance. you may also be kind and sociable, with self-acceptance among the learning themes.
reviewNotes: This is the source’s combined Aries/House 1 account. Retains its tension between seeking acceptance/acting for others and asserting individuality, with the gentler example’s independence theme.
Excludes childhood/adolescence as a presumed event, repression/trauma, self-harm or suicide references, therapist/healer claims, and guaranteed healing.

The gentler example at280-281 contributes kindness/sociability as well as independence/individuality; the presumed childhood-event clause at282-283 is not adopted. Self-acceptance is a learning theme, not a healing guarantee.

Taurus.pt: com Quíron em Touro ou na Casa 2, você pode sentir insegurança em torno do seu valor, do merecimento e da segurança material. a dor de perder e a culpa ao ganhar aparecem como temas dessa leitura, junto da busca por valores próprios.
Taurus.en: with Chiron in Taurus or the 2nd House, you may feel insecure about your own worth, deserving, and material security. pain around loss and guilt about gaining are themes in this reading, alongside the search for your own values.
reviewNotes: This is the source’s combined Taurus/House 2 account. Preserves the specific sensitivity around loss, guilt in gaining, and personal worth at 372-375 as possible themes, not events or predictions; keeps material values/security in view.
Excludes body-image/health claims, financial pathology, and cure/healing promises.

Loss-related pain and guilt specifically about gaining remain distinct as stated at373; guilt is not reassigned to losing. These are interpretive themes, not asserted events or financial predictions. The self-worth clause is supported at388.

Gemini.pt: com Quíron em Gêmeos ou na Casa 3, você pode sentir insegurança nas próprias ideias, com a liberdade de expressão entre os temas importantes. uma mente versátil e rápida e um estilo próprio de comunicação podem conviver com dificuldade para falar do seu lado emocional.
Gemini.en: with Chiron in Gemini or the 3rd House, you may feel uncertain about your own ideas, with freedom of expression among the important themes. quick, versatile thinking and an individual communication style may coexist with difficulty expressing your emotional side.
reviewNotes: This is the source’s combined Gemini/House 3 account. Uncertainty around one’s ideas/expression is paired with the source’s possible quick, versatile thinking and individual communication style.
Excludes school/childhood biography, diagnoses and stigmatizing claims, sibling illness or relationship predictions, and therapeutic/healing outcomes.

The insecurity clause concerns ideas; freedom of expression is a distinct stated need at409. The emotional-expression difficulty at418 qualifies the communicative strengths, without diagnosis or childhood explanation.

Cancer.pt: com Quíron em Câncer ou na Casa 4, você pode sentir uma ligação forte com a humanidade e insegurança diante da possibilidade de falhar. comunidade, raízes e a busca por um lar mais amplo também podem ganhar destaque.
Cancer.en: with Chiron in Cancer or the 4th House, you may feel a strong connection with humanity and insecurity around the possibility of failure. community, roots, and the search for a broader sense of home may also come into focus.
reviewNotes: This is the source's combined Cancer/House4 account. The first sentence retains humanity and insecurity around possible failure at431-435; the second retains community and the wider-home/roots themes at455-456. No fixed family history is inferred.

Excludes claims about a parent’s gender, rejection, abandonment, death, parental separation, childhood trauma, and relationship consequences. No universal house-parent convention or fixed family history is inferred.
A15:431-435 directly supports humanity, insecurity around failure and community;455-456 supports the wider-home/roots theme. No parent-gender convention or personal displacement event is inferred.

Leo.pt: com Quíron em Leão ou na Casa 5, você pode encontrar tensão entre o prazer de criar e a necessidade de ser reconhecido. seu estilo próprio e a possibilidade de incentivar a criatividade de outras pessoas também fazem parte desse tema.
Leo.en: with Chiron in Leo or the 5th House, you may find tension between the pleasure of creating and the need for recognition. your individual style and the possibility of encouraging other people's creativity are also part of this theme.
reviewNotes: This is the source’s combined Leo/House 5 account. Retains creativity/self-expression/recognition as sensitive themes and the qualified possibility of supporting others’ creative development.
Excludes childhood repression or nonacceptance as presumed events, sexual/health claims, child or partner outcomes, therapeutic prescriptions, and promised healing or satisfaction.

The recognition-versus-creative-pleasure tension is grounded at468-473 rather than an invented motive. The helping-creativity theme at485-486 does not promise therapeutic, child or personal satisfaction outcomes.

Virgo.pt: com Quíron em Virgem ou na Casa 6, seu modo de trabalhar pode ser marcado pela atenção aos detalhes e pela cobrança de perfeição. seu desejo de ajudar pode conviver com o receio de que outras pessoas se aproveitem de você.
Virgo.en: with Chiron in Virgo or the 6th House, your way of working may be marked by attention to detail and demands for perfection. your desire to help may coexist with concern that others could take advantage of you.
reviewNotes: This is the source’s combined Virgo/House 6 account. Retains work/detail/exacting standards and the tension between wanting to help and concern about being used as possibilities.
Excludes body dissatisfaction, illness, medical/therapeutic claims, dietary/exercise/meditation advice, hypochondria, and healing outcomes.
The fear of being used is retained as a concern, not as the source's guaranteed exploitation outcome. Work/detail/perfection and helping-versus-concern are grounded directly at492 and496-497.

Libra.pt: com Quíron na Casa 7 ou em Libra, você pode precisar bastante do contato com outras pessoas e nem sempre achar fácil flexibilizar sua própria posição. cooperar, dividir e reconhecer suas necessidades e seu espaço individual podem ser temas de aprendizado nas relações.
Libra.en: with Chiron in House 7 or Libra, you may need contact with other people and may not always find it easy to flex your own position. cooperation, sharing, and recognizing your needs and individual space may be learning themes in relationships.
reviewNotes: The account explicitly combines House 7 and Libra. Lines 529-530 describe a strong need for contact and learning to cooperate/share, with flexibility named separately at 531; lines 550-551 and 561-568 support personal needs and individual space. Copy does not turn cooperation into an innate preference or value, and does not claim rejection, childhood cause, partner behavior, separation or marriage outcome.

The source's therapist/cure language, sexualized framing, rejection biography, family and childhood claims, dependency scripts and imperatives are excluded. The shared sign-or-house portrait is not a claim that signs and houses are equivalent in all astrology.

Scorpio.pt: com Quíron na Casa 8 ou em Escorpião, você pode perceber tensões ligadas à sexualidade, aos valores espirituais e a sentimentos intensos, junto de questões de poder e controle. compreender a própria vulnerabilidade e partilhar recursos podem ser temas importantes nesse campo.
Scorpio.en: with Chiron in House 8 or Scorpio, you may encounter tensions involving sexuality, spiritual values and intense feelings, alongside questions of power and control. understanding your own vulnerability and sharing resources may be important themes in this area.
reviewNotes: The account explicitly combines House 8 and Scorpio. Lines 569-571 say sexuality and spiritual values may cause conflicts, without specifying that they conflict with each other; line 578 names intense feelings, line 575 power/control, lines 582-588 financial vulnerability, and 610-612 sharing resources. The copy preserves these as possible themes and does not claim the native's rejection, dysfunction, abuse history, partner outcome or deficient trust.

Excluded sexual dysfunction, abuse/incest/rape, birth or near-death trauma, illness, suicide, regression, clinical labels, therapist/healing claims, guaranteed recovery and imperatives. The mention of death is not turned into a prediction. Confidence in another person mentioned at 610 is not converted into a claim about the native's own trust.

Sagittarius.pt: com Quíron na Casa 9 ou em Sagitário, você pode buscar propósito e significado por meio de símbolos, ideias e diferentes filosofias. convicções distintas podem trazer desafios, enquanto comunicar conceitos abstratos e aprender a conviver com diferenças se tornam temas importantes.
Sagittarius.en: with Chiron in House 9 or Sagittarius, you may seek purpose and meaning through symbols, ideas and different philosophies. differing convictions may bring challenges, while communicating abstract concepts and learning to live with differences become important themes.
reviewNotes: The account explicitly combines House 9 and Sagittarius. Copy draws on symbolic/abstract communication, seeking meaning and purpose, the possibility of clashing with people who follow a different philosophy (619-620), and learning to live with differences (643-645). These are framed as a challenge and learning theme, not fixed intolerance or an assumed openness trait.
Excluded religious or spiritual prescriptions, guru exploitation, mental-health language, guaranteed cure/liberation, fixed beliefs or biography, and imperatives.

Capricorn.pt: com Quíron na Casa 10 ou em Capricórnio, você pode questionar que lugar ocupa no mundo e sentir pressão em torno de metas e reconhecimento profissional. a autocobrança pode acompanhar a busca por uma vocação própria, e diferentes formas de contribuir profissionalmente continuam tendo valor.
Capricorn.en: with Chiron in House 10 or Capricorn, you may question your place in the world and feel pressure around goals and professional recognition. self-pressure may accompany seeking your own vocation, and different forms of professional contribution still have value.
reviewNotes: This is the source's combined Capricorn/House10 account. Copy retains uncertainty about one's role, goals, professional recognition, self-pressure and vocation, then the qualification that different professional roles have value. It does not promise a rank, success, or a mentoring outcome.
Excluded claims about maternal rejection, parents, childhood, fixed therapist identity, inevitable professional failure/success, age or maturity timing, diagnosis and prescriptive career guidance.

The final qualification retains676-679: professional roles have value without ranking people as better or worse. It does not invent a desire for distinctive contribution or promise recognition, rank or success.

Aquarius.pt: com Quíron na Casa 11 ou em Aquário, você pode sentir sensibilidade em torno do pertencimento a grupos e da rejeição, junto de interesse por causas sociais. lidar com pessoas diferentes e com imperfeições na vida coletiva pode se tornar um tema importante.
Aquarius.en: with Chiron in House 11 or Aquarius, you may feel sensitivity around belonging to groups and rejection, alongside an interest in social causes. engaging with people who differ from you and with imperfections in collective life may become an important theme.
reviewNotes: The account explicitly combines House 11 and Aquarius. The copy retains group participation, social causes, rejection sensitivity and engaging with differences as possible themes, without asserting the person has experienced rejection.

Excluded guaranteed leadership, group success, fixed social or political identity, diagnosis, spiritual healing and imperative advice. The shared sign-or-house portrait does not establish universal sign/house equivalence.

Pisces.pt: com Quíron na Casa 12 ou em Peixes, você pode perceber frustrações coletivas e captar sentimentos alheios, com interesse pela vida interior e pelo que ultrapassa o visível. sonhos e imaginação podem funcionar como proteção, enquanto a atenção à vida prática também permanece importante.
Pisces.en: with Chiron in House 12 or Pisces, you may perceive collective frustrations and pick up on others’ feelings, with an interest in inner life and what goes beyond the visible. dreams and imagination may serve a protective function, while attention to practical life remains important too.
reviewNotes: The account explicitly combines House 12 and Pisces. Copy retains inner life, dreams as possible protection (742), the unknown, practical-life attention (727-729, 746) and sensitivity to collective frustrations/others' feelings as possible themes. The gentler combined example contributes only the narrow collective-frustrations clause at 288-289.

Excluded prenatal claims, drugs, depression, delusions, victim identity, carrying others' pain as fixed fact, spiritual healing promises, destiny/evolution language, and instructions. Citations at 713, 727-729, 740-742 and 746 include adjacent material not adopted; this note identifies the specific adopted clause portions and limits. The protective function is retained as source symbolism, not a clinical diagnosis or guaranteed coping outcome.

A15:714-716 supports interest in the unconscious/hidden realities; the prenatal clause sharing714 is not adopted. Dreams-as-protection is a possible function stated at742, not an instruction or clinical outcome.

mercury.pt: com Mercúrio retrógrado, você pode achar difícil transmitir com clareza o que sabe e sentir que os outros não acompanham sua maneira de pensar. pode voltar a dúvidas até entender o assunto com profundidade; o aprendizado envolve manter a atenção no presente e expressar suas descobertas a partir dele.
mercury.en: with retrograde Mercury, you may find it difficult to convey what you know clearly and feel that others do not follow your way of thinking. you may return to questions until you understand a subject deeply; learning involves keeping attention in the present and expressing your discoveries from there.
reviewNotes: The course presents reincarnation and unresolved karma as its framework; the description does not assert past-life facts. Lines 555-564 describe separation as something learned, not an innate coldness. Excluded the sexual-orientation diagnosis at 591-595 and the unsupported universal idea of access to earlier universal ideas at 534-540.

O livro suplementar (122023-122032,122055-122068, contexto122075-122166) adota outra abordagem: não distingue o retrógrado como perfil natal duradouro e enfatiza períodos ou escolha de datas. A16 tem precedência para estes perfis natais; não se misturam os contextos, nem se importam práticas.

venus.pt: com Vênus retrógrado, você pode internalizar mágoas e dar peso maior às imperfeições no amor, enquanto nem sempre reconhece com clareza o que sente ou prefere. a insegurança pode levar você a buscar proximidade e depois afastar os outros, enquanto padrões amorosos ligados ao passado podem se repetir.
venus.en: with retrograde Venus, you may internalize hurts and give greater weight to imperfections in love, while not always recognizing clearly what you feel or prefer. insecurity may lead you to seek closeness and then push others away, while love patterns linked to the past may recur.
reviewNotes: The course frames karma through a past-life account; the body recasts this as a symbolic pattern, not a verified biography. Excluded gendered claims and the sexual-orientation stereotyping/diagnosis at 1338-1348, as well as deterministic claims about love or relationships.

O livro suplementar (122023-122032,122055-122068, contexto122075-122166) adota outra abordagem: não distingue o retrógrado como perfil natal duradouro e enfatiza períodos ou escolha de datas. A16 tem precedência para estes perfis natais; não se misturam os contextos, nem se importam práticas.

mars.pt: com Marte retrógrado, você pode ter dificuldade para coordenar pensamentos e ações, em contato imperfeito com suas próprias necessidades. pode projetar papéis imaginados do passado nas relações atuais e reagir com raiva, hostilidade ou desconfiança.
mars.en: with retrograde Mars, you may have difficulty coordinating thoughts and actions while remaining out of touch with your own needs. you may project imagined past roles onto present relationships and react with anger, hostility, or mistrust.
reviewNotes: The course states past-life and relationship claims as facts; they are retained only as a symbolic tendency, not biography. The body changes its categorical account to a possibility. Excluded the sexual and gendered claims and the diagnosis-like characterization from 2042-2044 and 2051-2066. The karma section continues to line 2085, but its later clauses were outside the adopted range.

O livro suplementar (122023-122032,122055-122068, contexto122075-122166) adota outra abordagem: não distingue o retrógrado como perfil natal duradouro e enfatiza períodos ou escolha de datas. A16 tem precedência para estes perfis natais; não se misturam os contextos, nem se importam práticas.

jupiter.pt: com Júpiter retrógrado, você pode desenvolver padrões próprios de justiça e ética, guiados mais por sua avaliação interior do que pelas opiniões ao redor. pode buscar a essência das ideias e preservar a individualidade; seu aprendizado envolve introspecção, suspender o julgamento dos outros e ter paciência ao expressar suas convicções.
jupiter.en: with retrograde Jupiter, you may develop your own standards of justice and ethics, guided more by your inner assessment than by the opinions around you. you may seek the essence of ideas and preserve your individuality; your learning involves introspection, withholding judgment of others, and patience when expressing your convictions.
reviewNotes: The course qualifies motivation with 'if well-aspected' (2656) and rancor as an exception under difficult aspects (2664-2669); neither was made a universal trait. Prior-incarnation and déjà-vu claims at 2645-2647 and 2684-2693 were not stated as factual biography. The supplemental book's retrograde account is time-dependent and was not used to alter these natal passages.

O livro suplementar (122023-122032,122055-122068, contexto122075-122166) adota outra abordagem: não distingue o retrógrado como perfil natal duradouro e enfatiza períodos ou escolha de datas. A16 tem precedência para estes perfis natais; não se misturam os contextos, nem se importam práticas.

saturn.pt: você pode levar a sério o que ainda precisa completar e voltar a tarefas que sente terem ficado inacabadas, agindo com reflexão e cautela. você pode sentir gratidão pelo que aprende, e a maturidade pode surgir com esforço pessoal; concluir lições com paciência e aplicar o que aprendeu são temas de aprendizagem.
saturn.en: you may take seriously what still needs completing and return to tasks you feel were left unfinished, acting thoughtfully and cautiously. you may feel gratitude for what you learn, and maturity may come through personal effort; completing lessons patiently and applying what you have learned are learning themes.
reviewNotes: The source presents unfinished past work, prior lives, God, and incarnation-specific karma as facts (3279-3287, 3295-3305, 3307-3314). Body reframes these as felt incompletion, gratitude, effort, and learning themes; it does not assert a past-life biography or divine debt.
The source says Saturn retrograde is especially natural/comfortable (3310-3314); not included as a universal ranking.

O livro suplementar (122023-122032,122055-122068, contexto122075-122166) adota outra abordagem: não distingue o retrógrado como perfil natal duradouro e enfatiza períodos ou escolha de datas. A16 tem precedência para estes perfis natais; não se misturam os contextos, nem se importam práticas.

uranus.pt: você pode resistir ao que sente que o prende e defender ideias originais, mesmo quando elas tornam difícil sentir-se compreendido ou acompanhado. pode haver conflito entre impulsos mentais e emocionais que apontam direções diferentes; expressar sua liberdade interior é um tema de aprendizagem.
uranus.en: you may resist what feels constraining and defend original ideas, even when they make it hard to feel understood or accompanied. mental and emotional impulses may conflict and point in different directions; expressing your inner freedom is a learning theme.
reviewNotes: The source's personality passage calls for rebellion and predicts losses of friends, jobs, romances, and loneliness (3873-3888). Body retains resistance/originality and frames social cost as difficulty feeling understood, without guaranteeing losses.
The karma section's past-life independence claim (3914-3916) is excluded as fixed biography; the body retains only inner freedom and conflicting impulses as learning themes.

O livro suplementar (122023-122032,122055-122068, contexto122075-122166) adota outra abordagem: não distingue o retrógrado como perfil natal duradouro e enfatiza períodos ou escolha de datas. A16 tem precedência para estes perfis natais; não se misturam os contextos, nem se importam práticas.

neptune.pt: você pode ter motivações difíceis de explicar aos outros e percepções mais ligadas à vida interior do que à realidade material; também pode viver uma espiritualidade intensa ou sentir grande afinidade com a música. um tema de aprendizagem é distinguir o que é real daquilo que parece realizar seus sonhos, integrando percepções e ideais sem projetar sonhos passados sobre o presente.
neptune.en: you may have motivations that are hard for others to understand and perceptions more connected to inner life than to material reality; you may also experience strong spirituality or feel a great affinity for music. a learning theme is distinguishing what is real from what seems to fulfill your dreams, integrating perceptions and ideals without projecting past dreams onto the present.
reviewNotes: The personality section describes spiritual connection and perception beyond the material plane (4444-4454); body presents this as an intuitive or ideal mode of perception, not as verified supernatural knowledge.
The karma section explicitly frames discernment and integration as learning (4456-4471). Body retains those as learning themes and avoids declaring past lives or incomplete past events as facts.

O livro suplementar (122023-122032,122055-122068, contexto122075-122166) adota outra abordagem: não distingue o retrógrado como perfil natal duradouro e enfatiza períodos ou escolha de datas. A16 tem precedência para estes perfis natais; não se misturam os contextos, nem se importam práticas.

pluto.pt: você pode sentir os problemas da sociedade como um chamado pessoal à transformação interior e reagir fortemente à falta de honestidade das pessoas consigo mesmas. a consciência coletiva pode ocupar sua reflexão pessoal; desprender-se dos padrões e comportamentos alheios é um tema de aprendizagem ligado à sua identidade interior.
pluto.en: you may feel society's problems as a personal call to inner transformation and react strongly to other people's dishonesty with themselves. collective consciousness may occupy your personal reflection; loosening attachment to other people's patterns and behaviors is a learning theme tied to your inner identity.
reviewNotes: The source's purification, Christ-consciousness, and civilizational mission language (4851-4863) is not reproduced as a fixed spiritual destiny. The body keeps the stated inner-transformation motif in non-deterministic language.

The karma section's race-karma elevation and temporary life-stage withdrawal claims (4877-4886) are excluded as biography or fixed outcome. Collective consciousness/thought and inner reflection (4868-4876) are retained as symbolic learning themes.

O livro suplementar (122023-122032,122055-122068, contexto122075-122166) adota outra abordagem: não distingue o retrógrado como perfil natal duradouro e enfatiza períodos ou escolha de datas. A16 tem precedência para estes perfis natais; não se misturam os contextos, nem se importam práticas.

diurnal.pt: no seu mapa, o sect é diurno quando o Sol está acima do horizonte. nas profecções, o Sol é o luminar de sect associado aos nascimentos diurnos.
diurnal.en: in your chart, the sect is diurnal when the Sun is above the horizon. in profections, the Sun is the sect light associated with diurnal births.
reviewNotes: Aula 10 uses houses 7-12 as an illustration while explaining the Part of Fortune (2527-2529); that house range is not adopted as a general rule. The course defines above versus below the horizon but does not specify the exact-horizon boundary. The current implementation classifies using geometric altitude greater than its threshold, so an exact horizon is nocturnal; keep this source/implementation distinction in documentation.

nocturnal.pt: no seu mapa, o sect é noturno quando o Sol está abaixo do horizonte. nas profecções, a Lua é o luminar de sect associado aos nascimentos noturnos.
nocturnal.en: in your chart, the sect is nocturnal when the Sun is below the horizon. in profections, the Moon is the sect light associated with nocturnal births.
reviewNotes: Aula 10 uses houses 1-6 as an illustration while explaining the Part of Fortune (2527-2529); that house range is not adopted as a general rule. The course defines above versus below the horizon but does not specify the exact-horizon boundary. The current implementation classifies using geometric altitude greater than its threshold, so an exact horizon is nocturnal; keep this source/implementation distinction in documentation.

north.pt: no seu mapa, o nodo norte corresponde ao cruzamento ascendente da Lua pela eclíptica. ele simboliza uma direção de crescimento, ligada a transformar padrões ultrapassados e enfrentar experiências novas.
north.en: in your chart, the north node corresponds to the Moon’s ascending crossing of the ecliptic. it symbolizes a direction of growth, connected with changing outdated patterns and facing new experiences.
reviewNotes: Mat's settled convention is astronomical north/south with no hemisphere inversion. Aula 15's contrary southern-hemisphere inversion claim (33-45) is not applied to node identity; its dignity scheme (45-53) is retained as a separate symbolic correspondence. Benefic language is attributed to the teaching and does not guarantee benefit. Aula 21 places Dragon/house in a question about development goals, not a personality generalization.

O corpo combina a definição astronômica da A15 com a linguagem simbólica de desenvolvimento/recursos do livro, preservando os contextos distintos. A21:867-874 é um roteiro de leitura Dragão/casa e não fornece uma definição norte/sul; não foi usada como citação do corpo. Não afirma biografia de vidas passadas, destino fixo nem resultados garantidos.

Dignidades da A15, conforme decisão de Mat: norte domicílio Gêmeos, exaltação Aquário, exílio Sagitário, queda Leão; sul inverso (Sagitário, Leão, Gêmeos, Aquário). O contexto diferente da A12 permanece distinto; estas correspondências não alteram cálculos nem criam uma grade de personalidade.

south.pt: no seu mapa, o nodo sul corresponde ao cruzamento descendente da Lua pela eclíptica. ele simboliza talentos naturais, mas também uma bagagem de padrões e crenças que podem limitar sua perspectiva.
south.en: in your chart, the south node corresponds to the Moon’s descending crossing of the ecliptic. it symbolizes natural talents, but also accumulated patterns and beliefs that may limit your perspective.
reviewNotes: Mat's settled convention is astronomical north/south with no hemisphere inversion.
